requirement: Validate a numeric range: the minimum must be less than or equal to the maximum, and the unit must be null or a non-blank string.

preconditions.text: Validation runs on an in-memory range without database access

inputs.text: Range with min 0 and max 10, inclusive
Range with min equal to max (10 to 10)
Range with an exclusive lower bound (0 < x <= 10)
Range with min greater than max

returns.text: Single validation error for min greater than max
Single validation error reported on Unit for an empty unit

exception_text: No unhandled exception; invalid input is reported as validation errors
